# BA Advisory Desk

BA Advisory Desk is a senior Business Analysis service for teams that need Requirements Rescue Sprints, monthly Business Analysis support, decision ready business cases, SOPs, UAT support, process documentation, stakeholder synthesis, vendor readiness, AI assessments, AI governance frameworks, decision logs, and executive ready documentation.

## Primary Service Offers

- Requirements Rescue Sprint: one focused advisory sprint for a project that needs clearer requirements, scope, gaps, risks, priorities, and next steps.
- BA Advisory Desk Monthly Support: monthly senior Business Analysis support with 5 Advisory Credits, private intake, delivery tracking, and credit usage history.
- 3 Advisory Credit Top Up: 3 additional Advisory Credits for active clients.
- Custom Advisory Scope: scoped advisory work for larger diagnostics, readiness reviews, executive packages, or multi-workstream needs.

## Common Deliverables

- Requirements clarity packs
- Business requirements
- Functional requirements
- Non functional requirements
- Business cases
- Board and executive presentations
- SOP and process documentation
- UAT scenario packs
- Decision logs
- Gap and options analysis
- Stakeholder synthesis
- Vendor readiness packages
- AI assessment packs
- AI governance frameworks
- Custom advisory scopes

If a client does not see the deliverable they need, they can contact support@baadvisorydesk.com. BA Advisory Desk will review the requirement and confirm whether it can be delivered through Requirements Rescue Sprint, BA Advisory Desk Monthly Support, or Custom Advisory Scope. Active monthly clients can also top up Advisory Credits when additional capacity is needed.

## Best Fit Clients

- Software and SaaS teams
- Consulting firms
- Delivery leaders
- Transformation teams
- Public sector and private sector organizations
- Agencies and vendors that need senior Business Analysis capacity without hiring full time
